name: Asian Mental Health Collective
one_liner: A free nonprofit directory of Asian therapists in the US and Canada, searchable by state, language, ethnicity, insurance and focus.
best_for: Asian and Asian diaspora people who want a therapist who shares or understands their culture
People who want therapy in an Asian language
People who want to filter by insurance or private pay before contacting a therapist
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (US) or 9-8-8 (Canada)
People who want AMHC itself to provide, schedule or bill therapy
People outside the US and Canada
short_description: Free nonprofit directory of Asian therapists in the US and Canada. You pay the therapist you choose, by insurance or out of pocket.
long_description: The Asian Mental Health Collective (AMHC) is a nonprofit community organisation, not a therapy provider. Its free directory lists Asian therapists in the US and Canada and can be filtered by country, state, insurance or private pay, treatment focus, ethnicity, language and gender. AMHC says it attempts to verify each therapist's licence when they are listed; therapists must be able to practise in the state or province where you live. Therapy is arranged and paid directly with the therapist you choose, through your insurance or out of pocket, at their own rates. Separately, AMHC runs a Therapy Fund that offers accepted applicants 16 free sessions over 6 months with an Asian therapist; applications open once a year for people not previously accepted.
patient_summary: You search AMHC's free directory for an Asian therapist by state, language, ethnicity, insurance or focus, then contact the therapist yourself. Therapy is paid to the therapist, through your insurance if they take it or at their own self-pay rate. AMHC also runs a yearly Therapy Fund that gives some applicants 16 free sessions.

pricing.starting_price: Free to search; therapists set their own fees
pricing.notes: The directory is free. You pay the therapist directly at their rates or through insurance if they accept it (filter by insurance or private pay). AMHC's Therapy Fund offers accepted applicants 16 free sessions over 6 months; one application per calendar year.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says AMHC does not sell or market personal information to third parties and lists only care, billing and legal uses for sharing; users can request erasure of their data.

seo.title: Asian Mental Health Collective: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: The Asian Mental Health Collective runs a free directory of therapists for Asian communities in the US and Canada, searchable by language and background.

faqs.q: How much does Asian Mental Health Collective cost?
faqs.a: Free to search; therapists set their own fees. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Asian Mental Health Collective before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Asian Mental Health Collective replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Asian Mental Health Collective connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Asian Mental Health Collective?
faqs.a: Asian Mental Health Collective is available on the web.

faqs.q: What does Asian Mental Health Collective include?
faqs.a: Language and background filters; Cost and insurance filters; US and Canada.

availability.note: US and Canada only. Directory of independent therapists; availability depends on therapists licensed in your state or province.
